zh.title: 巴基斯坦温德尔：客运经营者抗议持续
zh.summary: 当地媒体报道，奎达至卡拉奇客运协会抗议检查站待遇，部分客运服务受到影响。
zh.body: The Balochistan Post于11月26日报道，客运经营者25日在温德尔集会，抗议已持续四天。协会指称检查过程中的不当待遇影响客运服务。分析：争议集中于执法与运输经营之间的摩擦，若协商失败，客运服务可能进一步缩减。企业应向承运商确认班次、员工接送及替代交通安排。追踪协会后续决定、主管部门回应及实际班次恢复情况。来源为当地媒体报道。

en.title: Pakistan: Winder transport operators continue protest
en.summary: Local reporting describes a passenger transport association protest over checkpoint treatment and service disruption.
en.body: The Balochistan Post reported on 26 November that transport operators rallied in Winder on 25 November as their protest entered its fourth day. The association alleged mistreatment during inspections and disruption to passenger services. Assessment: the dispute concerns friction between enforcement and transport operations; failed negotiations could further reduce service availability. Employers should confirm schedules, staff transfers and alternative transport with providers. Track association decisions, official responses and actual service restoration. Source: local media reporting.
